_comment: Generated by app/sim/scripts/fetch-environment.ts. Values merge into SiteTerrain via applyEnvironment(). wind = mean vector the air moves towards (x east, y north), m/s.

sources.wind: NASA POWER climatology (MERRA-2), WS10M/WD10M annual mean
sources.windGustMps: NASA POWER WS10M_MAX; gust sigma approximated as (max − mean) / 4
sources.albedo: NASA POWER ALLSKY_SRF_ALB (CERES SYN1deg) annual mean
sources.soilType: ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0, 0–5 cm sand/silt/clay → USDA texture class
sources.sunElevationDeg: equinox noon sun elevation from latitude
